tri_barman.text: Welcome to the Albatross Bar. We've a quiz on Friday, a dance on Saturday, and on Sunday we recover. The beer comes by ship, so there are good weeks and bad weeks.

tri_dancer.text: The squaredance is our big one. A caller shouts the steps and everyone swings, and the whole hall shakes like a boat. We've done it for generations, and the floor has never once complained.
A fiddle, an accordion and the wind outside, and nobody leaves till the ship's bell goes. If a ship is in, nobody leaves at all.
